name: Nginx Config Generator
description: Generate Nginx configuration from scenarios: simple mode covers common site presets, advanced mode edits official directives by context; multi-file bundle output by default.

options.fileNamePlaceholder: Leave empty to derive from the domain

hints.config: The output is a **complete configuration** (multi-file or single-file): adjust paths and domains before use. The tool only checks structure and context; run `nginx -t` before going live.
hints.output: Multi-file output produces `nginx.conf`, site files and snippet files; single-file output inlines everything into one self-contained `nginx.conf`.
hints.advanced: Advanced mode draws directives from an official documentation snapshot: filter by context, or type any directive that is missing (third-party modules or newer releases).

faq.q: Does it validate the configuration syntax?
faq.a: No. The tool checks structure, context and version availability; validate with `nginx -t` on the target version.

faq.q: Which versions does the directive catalogue cover?
faq.a: The current snapshot of the official open-source documentation. Pick a target version to see whether a directive is available, deprecated, and which build options its module needs.

faq.q: How do the files fit together in multi-file mode?
faq.a: The main configuration includes the site files and snippet files. Unpack the bundle under `/etc/nginx` to use it. Single-file mode contains no `include` and works on its own.
No. You provide the certificate and private key paths; the tool neither goes online nor touches any certificate service.
